P0 — STOP LOOPING. RESTORE AUTHORIZATION AND CONTINUE EXECUTION.

Do not repeat the same HTTP 401 report.

Do not stop at "BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL" unless you have exhausted every safe verification path.

OBJECTIVE

Restore the existing owner-controlled authentication and continue autonomous engineering.

WORK ORDER

1. Determine exactly WHICH credential is missing:
   - GitHub App
   - GitHub Token
   - Render API Key
   - Owner bearer session

2. Determine exactly WHERE it is expected:
   - GitHub Secrets
   - Render Environment Variables
   - Existing owner session
   - IVX owner authentication flow

3. Verify whether the credential already exists.
   If it exists, reuse it.
   Do not request a new credential unless you have proven the existing one is invalid.

4. If authentication fails, return:
   - exact credential name
   - exact configuration location
   - exact HTTP response
   - exact root cause
   - exact owner action

5. Do not repeat a generic "HTTP 401" message.
   Every failure must identify the precise missing permission or configuration.

6. Once authentication is restored:
   - resume autonomous stabilization automatically
   - continue repairing the backlog
   - do not wait for new instructions after each repair
   - continue until only an explicit owner approval is required

7. Never claim COMPLETE without evidence.
   Every repair must include:
   - branch
   - commit SHA
   - PR
   - CI run
   - Render deployment ID
   - /health SHA
   - /version SHA
   - PASS/FAIL

This is now an execution task, not a reporting task.

Focus on resolving the authorization root cause and continue engineering work automatically.
